info.title: Upgrade Agent REST API
info.summary: Quote → execute → confirm airline, cruise, and rail upgrades from any AI agent.
info.description:
Plain REST access to the same functions the Upgrade Agent MCP server exposes, for agents that don't speak MCP.

**Flow.** (1) **Quote** — `POST /api/v1/quotes` runs a live, booking-specific eligibility check and returns the upgrade options with the operator's real bid ranges and fixed prices; `POST /api/v1/quotes/secure` does the same without the agent ever handling booking details (the traveler enters them on a secure page). (2) **Execute** — `POST /api/v1/offers` places a bid, buys an instant upgrade, or redeems points against the quote; `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/v1/offers/{offerReference}` change or withdraw it. (3) **Confirm** — `GET /api/v1/offers?quoteId=` reads back each offer's live status (submitted / pending / accepted / declined / cancelled).

**Payment.** A bid is a payment authorization. Card capture never passes through this API: every staged offer returns a `paymentUrl` on the operator's hosted page (pay-by-link), where the traveler completes payment.

**PII.** The booking reference and last name sent to `POST /api/v1/quotes` are used only for the upstream lookup — never stored, logged, or echoed. Quotes and offers carry only non-PII data (route, cabin, ranges, references).

**Change cap.** Each booking allows at most 3 offer changes through the API (placing is free; each modify counts). Quotes report `changesRemaining`; past the cap, modifications return 409 with code `REASON_CHANGE_LIMIT`.

**Ownership.** A quote is bound to the credential that created it; the same token works on this API and on the MCP server, so a quote started on one can be executed and confirmed on the other. Another caller's quote reads as 404.

**Partner scope.** A partner-scoped token (white-label) is limited to its own carrier: `carrier` may be omitted and is filled in; any other carrier returns 403 with code `PARTNER_SCOPE`. `GET /api/v1/me` reports the scope.

**Outcomes (webhooks + polling).** Bids settle 24–72h before departure. Subscribe with `POST /api/v1/webhooks` to receive `offer.status_changed`, `offer.accepted`, `offer.declined`, `offer.cancelled` and `checkout.paid` (see the top-level `webhooks` section for the delivery shape), or poll `GET /api/v1/offers/events?since=<cursor>`. Deliveries are signed Stripe-style: `X-UpgradeAgent-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>` — recompute over the raw bytes, compare in constant time, and reject |now − t| > 300s. `X-UpgradeAgent-Idempotency-Key` is stable per (quote, offer, status): dedupe on it. Payloads are non-PII (references, status, amount, cabin, route — never a booking reference or last name).

**Errors** are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`) with a machine-readable `code`.

get.description: The caller's kind (platform credential vs OAuth client), client id, and partner scope. A partner-scoped token is limited to its own carrier on every quote/offer/pricing/partner call (`carrier` may be omitted and is filled in); the response names that partner and its white-label MCP server.

The partner analytics product: what travelers and AI agents ask about one operator's upgrade program (by intent and route), the AI-check → bid → paid funnel by channel, the agent mix, AI visibility (share of answer per engine, who gets cited instead, what agents say, where answers are wrong), open content gaps/drift, and observed bid ranges. A partner-scoped token (the `partner` claim) is locked to its own operator and must NOT pass `partner`; an unscoped token must pass `partner`. Same object the MCP `partner_question_insights` tool returns in structuredContent.

schema.description: Slug, IATA code, or operator name — required for unscoped tokens, rejected for partner-scoped tokens.
Report window.

400.description: `partner` missing for an unscoped token, or invalid window.

get.summary: List operators that offer upgrade programs
get.description: The merged partner view the MCP `list_partners` tool returns, filterable by vertical, region, and product.
Resolved like the MCP `get_partner_info` tool: IATA code or operator name. Includes the official upgrade page URL.

schema.description: IATA code or operator name, e.g. 'AC' or 'Air Canada'.

get.summary: Carriers offering upgrades on an airport pair
get.description: Route-level discovery (the MCP `search_upgrade_options` tool with a route). Three labelled evidence layers, never blended: operator inventory (when that upstream is enabled on the deployment), observed upgrade ranges on the pair from anonymized eligibility checks, and hub / home-country matches that may serve the route but are explicitly not confirmed and carry no pricing.

schema.description: Origin airport IATA code, e.g. YUL.
Destination airport IATA code, e.g. LHR.
Travel date YYYY-MM-DD; scopes the inventory layer only.

200.description: Carriers on the route with their evidence basis.

400.description: origin/destination missing or not IATA codes; invalid date or cabin.

get.summary: Typical observed bid ranges for an operator
get.description: Low / typical / high per cabin, aggregated from anonymized eligibility checks (the MCP `get_upgrade_pricing` tool). No booking needed; the exact range for a booking comes from a quote.

schema.description: IATA code or operator name.

post.summary: Quote: live eligibility check for a booking
post.description: Runs the same path as the MCP `check_upgrade_eligibility` tool and stores a quote owned by the caller when the booking is transactable (ELIGIBLE or MODIFY). The booking reference and last name are used only for the upstream lookup — never stored, logged, or echoed. Agents that must not handle PII should use `/api/v1/quotes/secure`.

200.description: Checked, but nothing to transact (NOT_ELIGIBLE, PNR_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CONFIGURED, or ERROR); quoteId is null.

201.description: Transactable quote (status ELIGIBLE or MODIFY) with a quoteId.

post.summary: Quote without handling PII: traveler enters details on a secure page
post.description: The MCP `start_eligibility_check` equivalent. Returns a secure URL for the traveler; poll `GET /api/v1/quotes/{quoteId}` until the status is no longer PENDING.

201.description: Pending quote with the traveler's secure link.

get.description: The stored non-PII result (the MCP `get_eligibility_result` tool). A quote another caller owns reads as 404.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: The quote id returned by POST /api/v1/quotes or /api/v1/quotes/secure.

200.description: The quote — completed, or still pending the traveler's input.

404.description: Unknown quote, or owned by another caller.

post.summary: Execute: place a bid, buy an instant upgrade, or redeem points
post.description: The MCP `place_bid` tool. Validates the amount against the operator's live range and stages the offer; payment completes on the operator's hosted page (`paymentUrl`). When live submit is enabled, the first call without `confirm: true` returns 202 with stage `needs_confirmation` and submits nothing.

201.description: Offer staged or submitted; complete payment at paymentUrl when present.

202.description: Awaiting human confirmation — repeat with confirm: true.

400.description: Validation error, or ambiguous cabin/segment (code REASON_AMBIGUOUS_SELECTION).

404.description: Unknown quote, or owned by another caller.

409.description: Quote not ready, booking not eligible, or no offer options.

422.description: Amount outside the operator's range or invalid (REASON_PRICE_CEILING / REASON_PRICE_FLOOR / REASON_INVALID_AMOUNT).

503.description: Validated, but the hosted payment step didn't open — retry.

get.summary: Confirm: offers on the booking with live status
get.description: The MCP `get_bid_status` tool: live placed offers (submitted / pending / accepted / declined / cancelled), the cart, offers seen at quote time, and the current options.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: The quote id returned by POST /api/v1/quotes or /api/v1/quotes/secure.

200.description: Offers and cart for the quote.

404.description: Unknown quote, or owned by another caller.

patch.description: The MCP `modify_bid` tool. Each change counts toward the per-booking cap (3 by default); once reached the answer is 409 with code REASON_CHANGE_LIMIT and the current offer stands.

parameters.name: offerReference
parameters.description: An offerId from the quote's options, or an offerReference (operator order-change id) from a placed offer.

202.description: Awaiting human confirmation — repeat with confirm: true.

404.description: Unknown quote/offer, or owned by another caller.

409.description: Change limit reached (REASON_CHANGE_LIMIT), quote not ready, or not eligible.

delete.description: The MCP `cancel_bid` tool. Requires `confirm=true` (query or body) once the traveler has agreed; without it nothing is withdrawn (409 CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED).

parameters.name: offerReference
parameters.description: An offerId from the quote's options, or an offerReference (operator order-change id) from a placed offer.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: The quote id returned by POST /api/v1/quotes or /api/v1/quotes/secure.

404.description: Unknown quote/offer, or owned by another caller.

409.description: Confirmation required, quote not ready, or cancel not possible here.

get.summary: Itemized all-in cost of an offer before committing
get.description: The MCP `get_price_breakdown` tool: amount plus taxes/fees, total, and for a BID the operator's own bid-strength read.

parameters.name: offerReference
parameters.description: An offerId from the quote's options, or an offerReference (operator order-change id) from a placed offer.

parameters.description: The quote id returned by POST /api/v1/quotes or /api/v1/quotes/secure.

schema.description: Amount to price (omit for INSTANT).

200.description: Breakdown (available=false when itemized pricing isn't offered for this booking).

422.description: Reference not mappable to one option.

get.summary: Poll bid-outcome events (for clients without webhooks)
get.description: The MCP `get_offer_events` tool. The ordered log of bid-outcome events — the same events webhooks deliver — for one quote (`quoteId`) or for every quote this caller owns (omit it). Pass `since` = the previous response's `nextCursor` (or an ISO timestamp) to receive only what's new. A quote whose traveler hasn't completed the check yet returns an empty page, not 409.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: Limit to one quote the caller owns.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A `nextCursor` from a previous response, or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

schema.description: 1–200, default 50.

200.description: Events, oldest first, with the cursor for the next poll.

404.description: Unknown quote, or owned by another caller.

post.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive signed events when an offer's status changes (and when checkout completes). The response includes the signing `secret` exactly once. Deliveries are retried 3 times inline, then up to 8 more times over ~21h with exponential backoff; 20 consecutive failures disable the webhook. At most 10 active webhooks per caller.

400.description: URL rejected (WEBHOOK_URL_REJECTED: not https, private/loopback host, credentials in URL) or unknown events.

404.description: quoteId unknown or owned by another caller.

503.description: Webhook store unavailable on this deployment.

get.description: Subscriptions owned by the calling credential. Secrets are never returned.

404.description: Unknown webhook, or owned by another caller.
Unknown webhook, or owned by another caller.

post.description: Delivers a `ping` event signed with the webhook's secret so the receiver can verify its implementation end-to-end. Reports the receiver's status; 502 when it did not answer 2xx.

404.description: Unknown webhook, or owned by another caller.

502.description: Receiver did not answer 2xx (details in the body).

post.description: Any change of an offer's normalized status (submitted → pending → accepted / declined / cancelled), including the first time it is observed.

Stable per (quote, offer, status) — dedupe on it.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. VALIDATION, QUOTE_NOT_FOUND, QUOTE_PENDING, OFFER_NOT_FOUND, CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, REASON_CHANGE_LIMIT, REASON_PRICE_CEILING, REASON_PRICE_FLOOR, REASON_INVALID_AMOUNT, REASON_AMBIGUOUS_SELECTION, REASON_NOT_ELIGIBLE, REASON_NO_BID_OPTIONS, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.

stage.description: Offer stage when the problem came from staging an offer.

changesRemaining.description: Offer changes still allowed on this booking.

offerReferences.description: Candidate references when a selection was ambiguous.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document. Extension members are present only when relevant.

id.description: Event id — also the polling cursor (pass as `since`).

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 time of the observation that produced the event.

OfferEvent.description: One bid-outcome event, as returned by GET /api/v1/offers/events. Webhook deliveries carry the OfferEventPayload directly (with `id` added).

toleranceSeconds.description: Reject signatures whose t is more than this far from now (300).

oneOf.description: Last successful (2xx) delivery.

secret.description: The signing secret — shown ONCE. Store it; it is kept encrypted and never returned again.

oneOf.description: Receiver's HTTP status; null on timeout / connection error.

bookingReference.description: Booking reference / PNR. Used only for the upstream lookup — never stored, logged, or echoed.

carrier.description: Operator IATA code or name, if known.

purchaseType.description: BID (money offer, default), INSTANT (buy now at the operator's fixed price — omit amount), or POINTS (amount = points).

cabin.description: Target cabin when the quote has more than one option.

segment.description: Route 'YUL-LHR' or flight number when more than one segment is eligible.

confirm.description: Human-in-the-loop: set true to commit once the traveler has confirmed. When live submit is enabled, a first call without it returns 202 + stage needs_confirmation.

amount.description: The NEW amount in the offer currency.

offerReferences.description: All operator order-change ids created/affected by this call.

oneOf.description: Rejection token on failures.

currency.description: ISO currency, or PTS for points.

reference.description: Operator order-change id (live) or the option's offerId (snapshot).

liveStatusLines.description: Human-readable live status lines, one per placed offer.

options.description: Bid-eligible options with their current ranges.

mcpServer.description: The partner's white-label MCP server URL.
The MCP server this token should use (partner server for a scoped token).

available.description: False when itemized pricing isn't available for this booking.

pending.description: True when the operator hasn't returned itemized taxes/fees yet.

oneOf.description: The operator's own bid-strength read for this amount.
Share of answer-engine answers that cited or mentioned Upgrade Agent for prompts about this partner; null when nothing was observed.

total.description: Questions about this partner in the window, excluding Upgrade Agent's own traffic and synthetic test rows.

oneOf.description: Share of answers that named the partner.

notes.description: Data-availability notes (a source unavailable in this window).

PartnerAnalytics.description: Per-partner analytics report: demand, conversion, agent mix, AI visibility, content, observed pricing. Every section is empty-safe and carries a `note` when its source had nothing in the window. PII-free: question text is masked at capture.

excerpt.description: PII-masked excerpt of the engine's answer.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked bearer token. The WWW-Authenticate challenge points at the OAuth protected-resource metadata.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE (S256). Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) at /api/oauth/register; discovery at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

scopes.mcp: Quote, execute, and confirm upgrades (same scope as the MCP server).

bearerAuth.description: An OAuth access token (or a partner-issued static token) as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
